root_cause.text: The fallback search loops in vti6_tnl_lookup() failed to verify that candidate tunnels have wildcard (any) addresses, allowing non-wildcard tunnels to be incorrectly matched due to hash collisions.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `ipv6_addr_any(&t->parms.raddr)` to the first fallback loop and `ipv6_addr_any(&t->parms.laddr)` to the second fallback loop, directly addressing the missing wildcard checks. The commit message explicitly states: "The bug is that the fallback search loops in vti6_tnl_lookup() were missing checks to ensure that the candidate tunnel actually has a wildcard address."

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix vti6 tunnel lookup to correctly require remote address to be any when iterating the wildcard remote hash bucket, avoiding false matches due to hash collisions.
intent_record.what: Added condition `ipv6_addr_any(&t->parms.raddr)` to the if statement in the vti6_tnl_lookup function, next to the existing local address and device up checks.
intent_record.how: The lookup now only returns a tunnel entry if its remote address is the any (unspecified) address, preventing matches with tunnels that have a specific remote address but happen to fall into the same hash bucket.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix vti6_tnl_lookup to only match tunnels with an unspecified local address, preventing incorrect tunnel selection.
intent_record.what: Added condition `ipv6_addr_any(&t->parms.laddr)` inside `vti6_tnl_lookup` function to require local address be unspecified when matching a tunnel.
intent_record.how: The lookup now only returns a tunnel if the local address is the IPv6 unspecified address, filtering out tunnels with specific local addresses from this lookup path.

diff --git a/net/ipv6/ip6_vti.c b/net/ipv6/ip6_vti.c
index d440bb58552
bic_trace_step.reason: The added fallback loops (lines ~107-121) do not verify that the candidate tunnel has a wildcard (any) address for the non-matching endpoint. The first loop checks only local address equality, the second only remote equality, and neither checks that the other address is zero. This allows tunnels with non-wildcard endpoints to be incorrectly returned due to hash collisions, matching the root cause. No fix (such as adding checks for wildcard addresses) is present.

diff --git a/net/ipv6/ip6_vti.c b/net/ipv6/ip6
bic_trace_step.reason: The vti6_tnl_lookup() function in this commit separates wildcard tunnels (tnls_wc) from specific-address tunnels (tnls_r_l). There is no fallback loop that iterates over non-wildcard tunnels without verifying addresses, so the vulnerable construct described in the root cause is absent.

index d440bb58552
bic_trace_step.reason: The commit introduces fallback loops after the initial exact-match lookup. In these loops, only one address (local or remote) is checked for equality, and there is no verification that the other endpoint is zero (wildcard). For example, the loop with hash = HASH(&any, local) only checks ipv6_addr_equal(local, &t->parms.laddr) without ensuring t->parms.raddr is all zeros. This allows non-wildcard tunnels to be incorrectly matched due to hash collisions, which is precisely the vulnerable construct described in the root cause.
